info.title: MaxIO Console API
info.description: S3-compatible object storage server — single-binary replacement for MinIO

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: When set, `putObject` and `deleteObject` are evaluated under this prefix.

403.description: Access key or user is disabled

500.description: The session was revoked in memory but could not be saved

200.description: The stored rules (IDs generated, dates normalized)

parameters.name: versionId
parameters.description: Target a specific version instead of the current object.

parameters.description: Target a specific version instead of the current object.

400.description: Invalid version id or delete marker

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Expiry in seconds. Defaults to 3600, max 604800.

400.description: Invalid version id, delete marker or SSE-C object

200.description: User, keys, and inline policies removed

BinaryBody.description: Raw object bytes (upload body and download response).

policy.description:
The bucket policy JSON exactly as S3 `GET ?policy` returns it; `null`
when the bucket has no anonymous access.

canDelete.description: Caller may call DeleteBucket on this bucket.

buckets.description: Bucket names. Empty with `access` set means every bucket.

documentJson.description: Raw policy JSON. Used instead of `access` when set.

keyOnly.description: Omitted means true. The scope is stored on this key only. `false` is rejected: creating a key never grants the user.

documentJson.description: Policy saved with this key, when the request included a scope or document.

policySummary.description: Set when the key has its own policy. That policy only narrows the user.

LifecycleConfigBody.description:
A bucket lifecycle configuration (`GET` response and `PUT` body). An
empty list removes the configuration.

LifecycleExpiration.description:
Expiration of current object versions (`Days` or `Date`), or removal of
expired object delete markers (`ExpiredObjectDeleteMarker`).

date.description: ISO 8601 date at midnight UTC, e.g. `2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`.

LifecycleFilter.description:
Which objects a rule applies to. All set conditions must match (logical
AND). An empty filter matches every object in the bucket.

objectSizeGreaterThan.description: Only objects strictly larger than this many bytes.

objectSizeLessThan.description: Only objects strictly smaller than this many bytes.

prefix.description: Key prefix; empty matches all keys.

LifecycleRule.description:
One bucket lifecycle rule (JSON form, camelCase). Stored in
`.bucket.json` and used as-is by the console API.

id.description: Unique rule ID (≤255 chars). Empty → generated by `validate_rules`.

LifecycleTag.description: One object tag a rule filter requires (key and value must match exactly).

newerNoncurrentVersions.description: Number of newest noncurrent versions to retain (1–100).

noncurrentDays.description: Days after the version became noncurrent.

ObjectEncryption.description: Server-side encryption summary. Key material is never exposed.

keyId.description: Master key id that wraps the object key (SSE-S3 only).

inlinePayload.description: Bytes are at `{key}/.maxio.object` because this key is also a prefix.

partCount.description: Number of parts for multipart uploads.

emptyPrefixes.description: Prefixes that only contain a folder marker.

versionId.description: Version id of the new current version (`null` when versioning is off).

TagSetBody.description: A tag set (`GET` response and `PUT` body). An empty list clears the tags.
